hints.title: Barrier Topology
hints.text: A path from the origin to the opposite corner is blocked if and only if a continuous chain of overlapping circles connects the top or left border to the bottom or right border.

hints.title: Boundary Virtual Nodes
hints.text: Create two virtual boundary components: one representing the top-left boundaries and the other representing the bottom-right boundaries.

hints.title: Geometric Connectivity
hints.text: Add edges between overlapping circles. Run traversal from the top-left boundary component. If the bottom-right boundary becomes reachable, the path is blocked.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Pairwise geometric intersection checks followed by linear graph traversal.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Grid continuous space simulation cannot discretize fractional barrier curves.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Adjacency graph of size m+2 easily fits in memory for m <= 1000.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Translates continuous 2D motion planning into boundary barrier connectivity.
